title: Upcoming release Cast Cats with AI generated images.
author: WerFEST

comments.author: WerFEST
comments.body:
We don't have any artists in the studio. 



We decided to try making a game with generated cats (everyone loves cats, right?). 

Each picture was manually processed in Photoshop to create uniqueness and fix generation errors. 



For me, as a developer, this is a great experience to try my hand at a game in the "find the differences" genre and release DLC in the future, since there is a huge scope for the game. 

My first game Airborne Sea does not imply any meaningful DLC. And here a whole scope opens up. 



Well, with your permission, I will attach a link: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118450/Cast\_Cats/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118450/Cast_Cats/)

I will be glad to receive reviews and additions to the WISHLIST. 



Meow to all! <3

comments.author: DuckGod-Dev
comments.body: ai tools are very grey zone in steam, many risks to make game with it so openly, hope you will dont get any troubles for it. Wish you luck
